events.text: I'm noting that there aren't enough credits to finish this, so I'll be upfront about that. I also want to flag that the 9:16 reframe has a limitation I should mention.

I couldn't make your clip. Magic Hour turned down the captioning job because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and no download link exists.

**What I tried:** English captions generated automatically from what she says, across the full 10 seconds. The audio was set to stay untouched, so her original voice would be kept. Because you were worried about captions pulling attention away from her, I chose a simple style. It used white text with a thin black outline, centred near the bottom of the frame so it sits below her face. I left out the word-by-word highlighting effect, which tends to draw the eye most.

**The 9:16 crop isn't available here either.** None of these tools can simply crop or reframe a video. The only one that could change the frame is an AI video editor, which redraws the whole clip and might alter how she looks or sounds. So I can't promise a 9:16 version that keeps her centred and keeps her original voice. The safest way is to crop the clip to 9:16 yourself in any basic video editor, keeping her in the middle, and then add the captions. If you add the captions before cropping, the crop could cut them off.

**To go ahead:**
1. Add credits to your Magic Hour account, or upgrade your plan.
2. Send me the 9:16 version of the clip, or tell me to use the original.
3. I'll add the captions with the same settings and send you the download link.
